name: Amara Shigataaru Kurain
original_name: アマラ・シガタール・クライン
source: The previous beloved queen of Khura'in who was assassinated by her husband Dhurke 23 years ago. In truth, it was a crime set up by Ga'ran to usurp the throne from her sister. She is the biological mother to both Nahyuta and Rayfa.
